messages.subject: SmoothCon error : unused arguments
parts:
Hi folks,

I have run into an issue when trying to run a smoother using the smoothCon() function.
Everything was working fine and i had run several GAMs, but now all of a sudden i am receiving the following error message when i run the below code:

> library(mgcv)
> basis_bath <- smoothCon(s(bath.std, bs = "bs", k = 10, fx = TRUE), 
+                        data = Skate,  
+                        knots = NULL, absorb.cons = TRUE)[[1]]$X
Error in s(bath.std, bs = "bs", k = 10, fx = TRUE) : 
  unused arguments (bs = "bs", k = 10, fx = TRUE)

I cleared my workspace data, closed the program and managed to get it working again., but then the error message came back. I also tried running Chapter 22's code and data from "Beginner's Guide toSpatial, Temporal and Spatial-Temporal Ecological Data Analysis with R-INLA (2017)", which included a couple of GAMs, and the error message came up there. 

I was able to run the code without issue an hour ago, but i am really scratching my head now. Is there something in the backend affecting how the function is running?

Any help would be greatly appreciated.

Sophie

messages.author: f3d71ca39a57d9c3
messages.subject: Re: SmoothCon error : unused arguments
parts:
I found the solution!

I had to coerse the s() :

basis_bath <- smoothCon(mgcv::s(bath.std, bs = "bs", k = 10, fx = TRUE), 
                       data = Skate,
